items.text: Hello, friends!
In this update, we made a major leap to the next engine version. In addition, we fixed several old bugs and added new floors. We hope you enjoy it!

The game has been upgraded to a new engine version: Unreal Engine 5.7. Some Workshop mods may not work for now. We are working on a new modding system, which we plan to present to players and modders in the near future.
Updated the Epic Online Services SDK.

Added a new floor to the Prison biome: Canteen.
Added the ability to drop a stack of items without using the inventory. Just hold Shift and press RMB while holding the item in the active slot.
Added a fading effect to hanging cables when the camera gets close to them.
Added ping display for clients in the Tab menu.
Fixed another issue where Steam Inventory item drops could be missing. Everything should now work correctly!
Slightly improved lighting across all locations.
Removed the pixelization option from the settings. We tried to find the most visually pleasing parameters for the PSX shader.
Fixed the collision of flaming barrels.

After switching to the new engine version, we encountered some issues with the updated API. All known issues have been fixed, but you may still encounter a bug in some specific case. If that happens, please let us know in the #bug-report channel on our Discord server. We will do our best to fix everything quickly!

items.text: Friends, hello!

It’s been a while since the last update, so we’re making up for it! You really thought the Gigastructure was nothing more than an endless slab of flesh and concrete? Come on—this place used to attract real minds. Or at least it did… a few decades back. Now? Well, you’ve seen what it’s like. Times change.

Back then, the best and brightest took over the oldest, most important sector of the Gigastructure—the Korolev Research Facility—and built a lab on its bones to study the Samosbor. But people like us were never big on restraint or playing it safe. Curiosity always won. It always does.
So yeah, the Facility’s fate was pretty much sealed from the start.
Now it’s your turn. Step inside what’s left of this abandoned research facility.

items.text: Hey everyone!

The release went fairly smoothly overall, though not without a few issues. We’ve moved quickly to fix the most critical problems and are sharing the list of changes below. We’re now tackling the remaining bugs. In the meantime, please continue sending us anything that concerns you via bug reports (Discord) — we’ll do our best to address everything as quickly as possible.
Once again, thank you for the warm reception and for your continued support throughout development!

Friends, hello!
Over the past few days, we’ve been quietly updating the game. So what have we been doing?

We fixed several crashes that were affecting stability. We also completely replaced the voice chat system — it now works reliably on both Windows and Linux, letting you switch your active device without issues and clearly hear your party members (echo and other effects are still there). Alongside these important changes, we added friend-based session filtering and fixed a few minor bugs.

We hope the game will feel more comfortable to play now. If anything still bothers you, let us know — we’ll keep rolling out quiet hotfixes. Meanwhile, we’re moving on to the release and getting ready to provide new content in the game’s beta branch soon. Stay tuned for updates — and thank you for being with us!
Friends!

To celebrate, we’re rolling out a small update with a little extra holiday cheer: we’ve swapped piles of trash for snowdrifts (almost all of them) and, as tradition demands, fixed a few bugs (???doors???).
Thank you for being with us through the mind-blowing year that was 2025. See you in 2026 — bright, unfiltered… and just a little bit fizzy. 🎄✨
Hey, friends!

Exactly one year ago, our dear Kletka entered Early Access. It’s been an unforgettable experience for us—and seeing how the game has transformed thanks to your help is beyond words. But still… Thank you.

With this update, we want to mark the end of Early Access. We’re now moving (actually, we moved a couple of weeks ago) to polishing the project and preparing it for release. Updates aren’t going anywhere—we’ll keep shipping them to Steam and EGS, but quietly, without separate news posts. Soon we’ll share the release date, details on the console porting process, and other important info.

As we promised, when 1.0.0 launches the game will keep its current price. And we won’t stop supporting the project after release: we have one major update planned. At least. For now, as we approach release, we’re preparing new additions on no smaller scale.

We’d like to thank our entire community once again for helping with development and for the reports you send—we read them regularly and keep adjusting gameplay accordingly. Please don’t stop—we don’t want even the tiniest bugs to ruin your release experience.
Thanks again, and… stay tuned for the worm fix.

If, when connecting to another player, your controls are broken or the game completely throws you back to the main menu, this means that you or the host has not updated the game.
